verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is a self-hosted, open-source crawling library that runs on the user's own infrastructure; there is no vendor-hosted service that ingests user data for model training, so a 'prevent training on my data' opt-out is a category mismatch rather than a missing feature. Any LLM training concerns would pertain to whichever third-party LLM the user chooses to plug in, not to Crawl4AI itself.
